canonical_project: AWS Bharat Future City hyperscale data centre
notes: Foundation stone laid by CM 15 Jul 2026 at Bharat Future City, Ranga Reddy district; flagship of AWS's Rs 60,000 crore (~USD 7 billion over 14 years, MoU Dec 2025) Telangana expansion. 202 acres allocated to Amazon in Bharat Future City. Capacity not yet published; construction just commenced.
